mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months signals an easing monetary cycle that reduces the cost of capital, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS trend is negative, or the Rank IC over 2015-2020 is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.50% in the prior month, it signals a tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.50%, or the Rank IC over 2018-2020 is below 0.05.
